title: Randomized Classifiers vs Human Decision-Makers: Trustworthy AI May Have to Act Randomly and Society Seems to Accept This
reasoning: The paper investigates the ethical foundations of AI decision-making, focusing on fairness and moral agency. It utilizes game theory and the Equality of Opportunity (EOP) principle to argue for randomized classification as an ethical necessity in cases of incomplete information, and evaluates societal moral preferences through a comprehensive survey provided in the appendix.
